featured_reviews.name: Tushar Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to share my recent experience with Shubham Driving School to ensure others are fully informed before enrolling. While I chose this school due to its convenient location and positive reviews, my experience with my assigned instructor, Rohit Kumar, has been highly disappointing.

Mr. Rohit demonstrated a significant lack of professionalism throughout our sessions. He frequently interrupted my driving lessons to purchase pan masala and would regularly spit while the vehicle was in motion. Furthermore, on my fifth day of training, he inappropriately demanded a bribe (baksheesh), claiming I had already mastered driving despite the fact that he had not yet taught me essential maneuvers like parking.

Based on this experience, I strongly recommend that prospective students thoroughly vet their instructors before committing. If you do choose this school, I suggest requesting to be taught personally by the owner, Milan Sir, who is a much more professional and capable instructor. Alternatively, I found "Good Luck" driving school to be a more professional option in the area.

A waste of money.

Counter staff is competent, giving a false impression of professionalism, because the actual driving instruction is pointless.
Cars are in terrible condition, instructors do not allow using the AC, even when you've paid for the option, and are too lazy to lift a finger to help or actually explain anything.
The teaching setup is 1/2 hour sessions only (no increase), but you are required to sit in their car for far more while the preceding and next drivers are adjusted - one student's session is determined by pickup/drop-off of the next.
In theory, that may not sound too bad, but in the Kemps Corner area, a half hour session of this involves driving for 10 mins, while the rest of your time is spent at traffic lights and waiting for other students. To say again - a waste of time and money.

featured_reviews.name: Sports Verse
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shri Gajanan Motor Training School is fine for learning the absolute basics, but the training is incomplete. They strictly keep you in 1st and 2nd gear, which doesn't prepare you for actual road conditions.
Once I started driving on my own, I realized I hadn't been taught how to downshift from 4th or 5th gear or how to accelerate smoothly on a slope without jerking the car. If you want to be a confident driver, you’ll likely need extra practice beyond their curriculum to handle higher speeds and inclines.
Pros: Decent for basic car control.
Cons: No high-gear training, lacks instruction on downshifting and slope management.

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Valivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent Driving Class is situated at Lower Parel, opposite Kamala Mills compound.

Charges - 7500 for 22 days + 4000 for license from RTO. Separate charges for using AC (in case the vehicle you practice on has AC option).

They have off on Thursdays. So no class.

The Theory lectures are conducted on alternate Sundays - 10-12 AM.

I took training for Ertiga, from Rakesh Master and is very professional, patient, a good teacher.

Learners license :
1. There is RTO exam application to practice questions with time option, so before going for exam you want to practice the questions.
2. In case you fail, you may re-appear for the test again one week after that date.
3. RTO charges 100 as fine for reappearing learners test.
4. There are 15 questions out of which 9 is passing.

Overall it has been a very good experience at Excellent Driving School. Very well trained Teachers / Driving masters. Responsive staff.  I have personally extended my period of class to get good hands on experience before driving test.
